en.ammaar-muslim: [4/1544] al-Kafi: A number of our companions from Ahmad b. Muhammad and Sahl b. Ziyad all together from Ibn Mahbub from Jamil b. Salih from al-Fudhayl b. Yasar from Abi Abdillahعليه السلام who said:
The one who has memorized the Qur’an and acts upon it is with the Honourable and Virtuous Scribes
